risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cyberattack and security breach risks due to the management of large volumes of personal data. A data breach could result in financial losses, reputational damage, and operational impacts.

risks.title: Food Safety
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to food contamination and food safety risks related to the preparation and sale of prepared foods. These risks could lead to financial losses and reputational damage.

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to supply chain disruption risks that could affect product availability and increase operating costs.
